raw: Consider obtaining CKA certification post-hire to fully satisfy the desirable certification requirement and deepen Kubernetes expertise.
Prepare specific examples of how your observability implementations (dashboards, alerting) prevented incidents or improved MTTR.
If applicable, ensure any machine learning, classification, or causal inference work is prominently featured in CV or portfolio.
Gain hands-on experience with at least one cloud data platform (AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse, or Snowflake) to future-proof technical skillset.
Document and be ready to discuss one end-to-end analytics project led independently, from requirements through delivery.
Familiarise yourself with key insurance metrics (loss ratios, frequency/severity, reserving, underwriting profitability) and be prepared to discuss how analytics support these areas.
Be ready to discuss code management practices (Git, code review, documentation) used in pipeline development.
Prepare specific metrics on design system improvements (e.g., component reuse rates, handoff efficiency gains) for interview discussion.
Emphasize travel and e-commerce project experience from Pinnate role to demonstrate familiarity with WanderNest's domain.
Develop 1–2 detailed examples of accessibility improvements championed to align with WanderNest's inclusive mission.
Complete a structured WCAG 2.1 course (e.g. Udacity, A11ycasts, WebAIM) and conduct an accessibility audit of a live website to demonstrate applied knowledge.
Study design system fundamentals (read 'Design Systems' by Alla Kholmatova or explore Storybook) and refactor the personal Next.js travel-planner project to include a documented component system.
Complete an advanced TypeScript course covering generics, utility types, and strict mode, then apply these patterns to a personal project.
Audit the personal travel-planner site using Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals, set performance budgets, and document optimization work.
Contribute to an open-source design system (e.g. Chakra UI, Radix UI, or Storybook) to gain real-world design system maintenance experience.
Explore his approach to problem-solving, team dynamics, and working style to ensure alignment with ArdenVale's culture and values.
Prepare 2–3 concrete examples of process changes you've identified and driven, not just implemented, to demonstrate continuous improvement mindset.
Research GlobePay's product suite, market position, customer segments, and competitive landscape to demonstrate genuine interest.
Identify and prepare to discuss a time you proactively suggested or led a tooling or process improvement with Product or IT, not just assisted in one.
Prepare a detailed case study of a complex escalation she handled to demonstrate problem-solving and communication under pressure.
